workbook: 角色动作需求表（增加小怪行为数据）.xlsb.xlsx
spring_rebirth: 用户确认与士兵一样默认等待7秒，可调

enemies.name: 石头人小怪
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Patrol

    state "Patrol 自行左右移动" as Patrol
    state "Hammer 停下攻击一次" as Hammer
    state "Ignore 无视玩家移动3秒" as Ignore
    state "Dead 死亡爆炸" as Dead

    Patrol --> Hammer : 玩家进入范围
    Hammer --> Ignore : 动画结束
    Ignore --> Patrol : 3秒计时到 / 继续检测玩家

    Patrol --> Dead : HP≤0
    Hammer --> Dead : HP≤0
    Ignore --> Dead : HP≤0
    Dead --> [*]

enemies.name: 自爆方块小怪
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Explode : 被撞到/受到攻击
    Explode --> [*] : 爆炸结束

enemies.name: 积木士兵
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Patrol

    state "Patrol 左右巡逻" as Patrol
    state "Attack 砍击" as Attack
    state "Ignore 无视移动" as Ignore
    state "Dead 散架暂时死亡" as Dead
    state "Rebirth 重新组装回来" as Rebirth

    Patrol --> Attack : 玩家进入范围
    Attack --> Ignore : 动画结束
    Ignore --> Patrol : 3秒计时到 / 重新检测玩家

    Patrol --> Dead : HP≤0
    Attack --> Dead : HP≤0
    Ignore --> Dead : HP≤0
    Dead --> Rebirth : 散架动画结束
    Rebirth --> Patrol : 重组动画结束

enemies.name: 弹簧小怪
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Patrol

    state "Patrol 向玩家跳跃（检测攻击）" as Patrol
    state "Attack 弯腰（范围1.5）" as Attack
    state "Ignore 向玩家跳跃（不检测攻击）" as Ignore
    state "Dead 散架暂时死亡" as Dead
    state "Rebirth 重新组装回来" as Rebirth

    Patrol --> Attack : 落地且玩家在1.5内
    Patrol --> Patrol : 落地未进1.5范围 / 等0.5s继续跳

    Attack --> Ignore : 动画结束
    Ignore --> Patrol : 3秒计时到

    Patrol --> Dead : HP≤0
    Attack --> Dead : HP≤0
    Ignore --> Dead : HP≤0
    Dead --> Rebirth : 散架动画结束
    Rebirth --> Patrol : 重组动画结束

enemies.name: 发条鼠
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle

    state "Idle 呆在地下（冷却）" as Idle
    state "Pop 钻出来" as Pop
    state "Walk 地上平移" as Walk
    state "Hide 钻进去" as Hide
    state "Dead 死亡" as Dead

    Idle --> Pop : 玩家进入3格范围 且 冷却结束
    
    Pop --> Walk : 动画结束
    Pop --> Dead : Hp < 0

    Walk --> Walk : 向左右移动 / 最多8格 / 碰到墙扭头
    Walk --> Hide : 第二次经过钻出点
    Walk --> Dead : Hp < 0

    Hide --> Idle : 动画结束 / 冷却3秒
    Hide --> Dead : Hp < 0

    Dead --> [*]

enemies.name: 发条炸弹
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle

    state "Idle 小范围踱步" as Idle
    state "Dash 冲向玩家" as Dash
    state "Explode 自爆" as Explode

    Idle --> Dash : 看见玩家
    Dash --> Explode : 碰到玩家 / 到达自爆条件
    Explode --> [*] : 爆炸结束，销毁

enemies.name: 毛绒玩具鸟
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Fly

    state "Fly 同一水平来回飞" as Fly
    state "Attack 丢法术球" as Attack
    state "Dead 死亡" as Dead

    Fly --> Attack : 玩家进入攻击范围 且 CD好
    Attack --> Fly : 动画结束

    Fly --> Dead : HP≤0
    Attack --> Dead : HP≤0
    Dead --> [*]

enemies.name: 抱抱熊
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle

    state "Idle 原地坐" as Idle
    state "Stand 站起来" as Stand
    state "Chase 缓慢追逐" as Chase
    state "Hug 抱住玩家持续扣血" as Hug
    state "Sit 回初始位置坐下" as Sit
    state "Dead 死亡（保持拥抱消散）" as Dead

    Idle --> Stand : 看见玩家
    Stand --> Chase : 站起来结束

    Chase --> Hug : 碰到玩家
    Chase --> Sit : 玩家离开索敌范围

    Hug --> Chase : 玩家挣脱 / 持续时间结束
    Hug --> Dead : HP≤0（保持拥抱动作消散）

    Sit --> Idle : 回到初始位置并坐下

    Idle --> Dead : HP≤0
    Stand --> Dead : HP≤0
    Chase --> Dead : HP≤0
    Sit --> Dead : HP≤0

enemies.name: 毛绒海豹
enemies.behavior_graph:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Wander

    state "Wander 随机移动" as Wander
    state "Slide 滑行（快速冲向玩家）" as Slide
    state "Howl 嚎叫" as Howl
    state "BellySlap 拍肚子（召唤冰块）" as BellySlap
    state "Dead 死亡（冰洞）" as Dead

    Wander --> Slide : 技能计时到 / 轮到滑行
    Wander --> Howl : 技能计时到 / 轮到嚎叫
    Wander --> BellySlap : 技能计时到 / 轮到拍肚子

    Slide --> Wander : 动画结束 / 撞到玩家
    Howl --> Wander : 动画结束
    BellySlap --> Wander : 动画结束 / 冰块已生成

    Wander --> Dead : HP≤0
    Slide --> Dead : HP≤0
    Howl --> Dead : HP≤0
    BellySlap --> Dead : HP≤0
    Dead --> [*]
